description: Annual metropolitan train station patronage (station entries) is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Total and daily average patronage (station entries) for Melbourne metropolitan train stations, including average patronage by time band, to allow users to analyse Melbourne metropolitan train patronage by station, day type, time of day and total annual. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are boardings, patronage, public transport, ridership, station. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
